## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check:all` and `pnpm build` pass locally.
- [ ] `pnpm test:docker` passes, if Docker, HTTP, or packaging changed.
- [ ] Tool names, schemas, annotations, descriptions, and profile membership changes have regression tests.
- [ ] `docs/api-contract-matrix.md`, `docs/api-quirks.md`, `docs/source-log.md`, and `docs/current-state.md` are updated where API evidence or shipped behavior changed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated for user-facing changes.
- [ ] No tokens, organisation IDs, project IDs, customer data, or signed URLs appear in code, fixtures, docs, or logs.
